A [[Human/Legends|Human]] named '''Admiral''' lived during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The individual was active as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]<ref name="Sith">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref> in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] and [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="Date">The opening crawl of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' states that the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] events take place five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'', which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> Admiral had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], fair skin, and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and a scar crossed down from the top of the Human's forehead, over the right eye, and onto the right cheek.<ref name="Jedi" />

Admiral wore a black [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] with a shirt that bore a red band past the right [[Limb/Legends|shoulder]]. The uniform also had a red collar and a set of symbols on the front and back of the shirt. Admiral wielded numerous [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] as a soldier, including an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]], a [[rail detonator]], and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]].<ref name="Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Admiral was introduced in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' as a character who only appeared in the game's multiplayer addition as one of the playable character models.<ref name="Jedi" /> The Human later appeared in ''Jedi Knight''{{'s}} [[1998]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith|''Mysteries of the Sith'']], which introduced "multiplayer personalities," a form of character creation that put different character models under different professions. Each profession had its own set of starting weapons for a match, with Admiral being categorized as a soldier. Admiral's face texture is the same one used for [[Santiago]], another multiplayer character in the game.<ref name="Sith" /> Neither game states whether "Admiral" is the character's name or an indicator of [[Military rank/Legends|rank]].<ref name="Jedi" /><ref name="Sith" />
